text: Jacory Croskey-Merritt is back at practice. The Commanders opened his 21-day window off IR, and he could return Monday night against the Bengals.
David Montgomery practiced fully and is trending toward playing Thursday against the Colts. Woody Marks (concussion) is unlikely to play.
Drake Maye is out indefinitely with a right ankle injury; Mike Vrabel doesn't expect him back right after the Patriots' bye.
Geno Smith is having more tests on a concussion and an ankle injury; his Week 11 status is unclear.
Baker Mayfield could miss Week 11 with a foot/ankle injury.
Omarion Hampton ran for 105 yards and a TD on 22 carries, and Justin Herbert ran one in, as the Chargers beat the Ravens 23-20 for their first win.
Derrick Henry scored twice despite just 10 rushing yards. Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards in his first Ravens start, but Baltimore has lost five straight.
The Patriots fear Drake Maye fractured his ankle in Munich. He could miss the rest of the season.
Jordan Addison needs thumb surgery and is headed to injured reserve.
Brock Bowers is day-to-day with an ankle injury that was not as bad as first feared.
Aidan Hutchinson is reportedly out for the season after hurting his right knee celebrating a sack of Drake Maye in Munich. A big hit to the Lions D/ST.
Drake Maye (ankle) was ruled out in the first quarter in Munich after Hutchinson's sack. Tommy DeVito finished the game; the Lions won 35-10.
Chiefs TE Jared Wiley (ankle) was carted off and ruled out against Atlanta. Noah Gray and Jake Briningstool pick up the tight end snaps.
Travis Kelce twisted his ankle on a 23-yard catch but returned to the game. The Chiefs beat the Falcons 35-13.
No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza ran in his first career touchdown on the opening drive of his first start against Seattle.
Kirk Cousins threw 2 TDs in his return to Lambeau and the Vikings had 8 sacks in a 30-10 win over the Packers.
Jahmyr Gibbs had 252 total yards and 2 TDs, and Amon-Ra St. Brown scored twice (rib and all) as the Lions beat the Patriots 35-10 in Munich.
Garrett Wilson cleared the concussion protocol and will play against the Bills.
Jordan Addison (thumb) is a game-time decision at Green Bay (1:00). Vikings inactives come out about 11:30 AM ET.
Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) and A.J. Brown (ankle) are active for the Patriots in Munich. Corey Kiner goes back to a backup role.
Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) is active for the Lions against the Patriots. Start him.
The Saints activated Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) from injured reserve. He is expected to play against the Panthers.
Jonathon Brooks (groin) was downgraded to out Saturday for Sunday's game at New Orleans.
David Montgomery (groin) was downgraded to out Saturday for Sunday's game at Cleveland. Woody Marks and Jawhar Jordan handle the Texans' backfield.
Kenneth Walker III (groin) has been ruled out Sunday against the Falcons. The Chiefs want to give him a week; rookie Emmett Johnson will lead the backfield.
Josh Jacobs (finger surgery) is out Sunday against the Vikings and could miss multiple weeks. Kaleb Johnson had 14 carries for 68 yards and a touchdown after Jacobs left last week.
Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) is questionable for the 9:30 AM ET kickoff against the Patriots in Munich. Set that lineup spot early.
Update: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is questionable for Sunday in Germany after limited practices Thursday and Friday. TreVeyon Henderson is out, so Corey Kiner still gets work either way.
David Montgomery (groin) is questionable after a full practice Friday. Woody Marks (knee) was cleared and plays.
Kenneth Walker (groin) is questionable for Sunday against the Falcons.
T.J. Hockenson (wrist), Kyler Murray (hamstring) and Jauan Jennings (calf) are out against the Packers. Jordan Addison (thumb) is questionable.
Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) is out against the Browns, which means more targets for Tank Dell, Nico Collins and Kayshon Boutte.
Jake Ferguson (knee) is out against the 49ers. George Pickens (hamstring) is off the injury report and set to return.
Commanders 24, Giants 21 on Thursday night. Isaiah Likely (27.7 PPR) and Cam Skattebo (27.2) led all scorers; Jayden Daniels threw 3 TDs.
TreVeyon Henderson (illness) is out for Week 10, so Corey Kiner should lead the Patriots backfield.
Puka Nacua (knee, turf toe) is headed to IR. The Rams hope to have him back around Week 14 or 15.
Malik Willis (groin) is on IR. Rookie Kyle McCord makes his first start Sunday against the Colts.
Rookie Fernando Mendoza is the Raiders' new starting quarterback. A small step down for Brock Bowers.
Gardner Minshew (elbow surgery) is out for the season. Rookie Carson Beck makes his first start for the Cardinals against the Rams.
Kirk Cousins is back in Minnesota, traded from the Raiders. He's expected to start, a boost for Justin Jefferson.
Josh Downs was traded from the Colts to the Chiefs.
Keenan Allen was traded from the Colts to the 49ers.
Jalen Hurts (blood clots) is out for the season.
Terry McLaurin (knee) is out for the season.
Sam Darnold (quad, ribs) is out for Week 10.
The Eagles traded DT Jordan Davis to the Jaguars for a 2027 first-round pick (No. 24 in our draft order) and a 2029 second.
The Falcons traded S Jessie Bates III to the Jaguars for a 2027 second-round pick (No. 55 in our draft order) and a 2028 fifth.
Patrick Mahomes' elbow MRI showed no major injury. He's expected to play Sunday at Atlanta.
Jacoby Brissett traded to the Ravens. He's starting while Lamar Jackson is on IR.
The Saints claimed RB Audric Estime off waivers from the Browns.
Davante Adams is ahead of schedule after hamstring surgery. Sean McVay expects him back on the short end of 6-10 weeks, possibly Week 12 or 13.
